layout.linkHint: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:
layout.footer: This is an automated message from Local WorkMan.

verify_email.subject: Confirm your email address
verify_email.heading: Confirm your email address
body: Thanks for signing up to Local WorkMan. Confirm your email address to finish creating your account. The link works once and expires in 24 hours.
verify_email.note: If you did not sign up, you can ignore this email.

already_registered.subject: You already have a Local WorkMan account
already_registered.heading: You already have an account
body: Someone tried to sign up to Local WorkMan with this email address. You already have an account, so no new one was created.
already_registered.secondary: Forgot your password? Reset it here:
already_registered.note: If this was not you, you can ignore this email. Your account has not changed.

recruiter_email_code.subject: Your Local WorkMan verification code
recruiter_email_code.heading: Your verification code
body: Enter this code to verify your work email address. It expires in 10 minutes.
recruiter_email_code.note: If you did not sign up, you can ignore this email.

password_reset.subject: Reset your Local WorkMan password
password_reset.heading: Reset your password
body: We received a request to reset your password. The link works once and expires in 1 hour. Resetting your password signs you out on every device.
password_reset.note: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

verification_approved.subject: Your {{check}} check is approved
verification_approved.heading: Check approved
body: An administrator reviewed your {{check}} evidence and approved it. The check now shows as verified on your profile.

verification_rejected.subject: Your {{check}} check needs new evidence
verification_rejected.heading: Evidence not approved
body: An administrator reviewed your {{check}} evidence and could not approve it.
You can submit new evidence from your verification page.

recruiter_approved.subject: Your recruiter account is approved
recruiter_approved.heading: Welcome to Local WorkMan
body: An administrator reviewed {{company}} and approved your recruiter account. Your recruiter workspace is now open: you can post jobs and discover candidates.

recruiter_rejected.subject: Your recruiter account needs changes
recruiter_rejected.heading: Your account was not approved yet
body: An administrator reviewed {{company}} and could not approve your recruiter account.
You can update your details or documents and submit them again.

recruiter_suspended.subject: Your recruiter account is suspended
recruiter_suspended.heading: Account suspended
body: An administrator suspended your recruiter account for {{company}}. Your jobs are hidden from candidates while it is suspended.

cv_request.subject: CV request from {{company}}
cv_request.heading: CV request
body: {{company}} asked to see an earlier version of your CV.
Nothing is shared unless you approve. You can choose which version to share, or decline, on your CV page.

renewal_failed.subject: We could not renew your {{plan}} plan
renewal_failed.heading: Payment failed
body: We could not take the {{amount}} payment for your {{plan}} plan. Stripe will try again over the next days, and you keep {{plan}} while it does.
Update your card in Billing so you do not lose access.

plan_ended.subject: Your {{plan}} plan has ended
plan_ended.heading: Plan ended
body: Your {{plan}} plan has ended. Applying, messaging recruiters, job alerts and the AI features are locked again.
Your applications, job alerts and messages are kept. Your alerts start again when you subscribe.

application_status.subject: Update on your {{job}} application
application_status.heading: Your application status changed
body: Your application for {{job}} at {{company}} is now: {{status}}.

application_rejected.subject: Update on your {{job}} application
application_rejected.heading: Your application was not selected
body: {{company}} reviewed your application for {{job}} and decided not to move forward with it.
Thank you for your interest. You can keep applying to other roles on Local WorkMan.

new_applications.subject: {{countLabel}} for {{job}}
new_applications.heading: New applications
body: Review them and move people forward from your Applications page.

new_message.subject: New message from {{sender}}
new_message.heading: You have an unread message
body: {{sender}} sent you a message on Local WorkMan.
Open the conversation to read it and reply.

alert_instant.subject: New job for your alert “{{alertName}}”: {{job}}
alert_instant.heading: A new job matches your alert
body: A job matching your alert “{{alertName}}” was just published:

alert_daily.subject: {{countLabel}} for “{{alertName}}”
alert_daily.heading: Your daily job alert
body: {{countLabel}} for your alert “{{alertName}}” since your last digest:
alert_daily.more: These are the {{shown}} newest. See all {{total}} jobs:

alert_weekly.subject: {{countLabel}} for “{{alertName}}” this week
alert_weekly.heading: Your weekly job alert
body: {{countLabel}} for your alert “{{alertName}}” since your last digest:
alert_weekly.more: These are the {{shown}} newest. See all {{total}} jobs:

certificate_issued.subject: Your certificate for “{{course}}”
certificate_issued.heading: You passed the course
body: You passed the final quiz of “{{course}}”. Your certificate {{code}} is ready to download.
Anyone can check it with its code.

admin_invite.subject: You are invited to the Local WorkMan admin workspace
admin_invite.heading: Join the admin workspace
body: {{inviter}} invited you to the Local WorkMan admin workspace with the role {{role}}. Set a password to finish your account. The link works once and expires in 72 hours.
admin_invite.note: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.

content_restricted.job: An administrator reviewed your job “{{title}}” and restricted it. It is paused and cannot be published again while the restriction applies.
content_restricted.profile: An administrator reviewed your profile and restricted it. Recruiters cannot find it in search while the restriction applies.

content_restriction_lifted.job: The restriction on your job “{{title}}” was lifted. It stays paused until you publish it again.
content_restriction_lifted.profile: The restriction on your profile was lifted. Recruiters can find it in search again.

moderationSummary.photoRemoved: Your profile photo was removed. Upload a new photo to complete your profile again.

adminSummary.accountSubmitted: {{recruiter}} ({{company}}) submitted their recruiter account for review.
adminSummary.accountResubmitted: {{recruiter}} ({{company}}) fixed their recruiter account and submitted it again for review.

admin_account_review.subject: Recruiter account to review
admin_account_review.heading: Account review
body: Check the company details and documents, then approve or reject the account.

admin_verification_submitted.subject: Verification to review: {{candidate}}
admin_verification_submitted.heading: Verification submitted
body: Review the document, then approve or reject it.

admin_renewal_failed.subject: Renewal payment failed: {{reference}}
admin_renewal_failed.heading: Renewal payment failed
body: The {{amount}} {{plan}} renewal of {{payer}} failed ({{reference}}). Stripe will try again over the next days.

admin_joined.subject: {{admin}} joined the admin workspace
admin_joined.heading: Admin joined
body: {{admin}} accepted the invitation and set a password. They can now sign in to the admin workspace.

recruiter_plan_ended.subject: Your {{plan}} plan has ended
recruiter_plan_ended.heading: Plan ended
body: Your {{plan}} plan has ended. Find candidates, starting conversations, CV requests, the AI tools and more than 1 active job are locked again.
Your applications, conversations, notes and shortlist are kept.

interview_invitation.subject: {{company}} would like to interview you
interview_invitation.heading: Choose an interview time
body: {{company}} invites you to an interview for {{job}}.
Pick one of these times (shown in your time zone), or ask for other times:

interview_rescheduled.subject: {{company}} offered new interview times
interview_rescheduled.heading: Pick a new interview time
body: {{company}} offered new times for your interview for {{job}}.
Pick one of these times (shown in your time zone), or ask for other times:

interview_other_times.subject: {{candidate}} asked for other interview times
interview_other_times.heading: Other times requested
body: None of the times you offered for {{job}} suits {{candidate}}.
Offer new times from the interview card.

interview_reschedule_request.subject: {{candidate}} asked to move the interview
interview_reschedule_request.heading: Reschedule requested
body: {{candidate}} asked to move the interview for {{job}} booked for {{when}}.
The booking stays until you offer new times or cancel it.

document_request.subject: {{company}} requested documents
document_request.heading: Documents requested
body: {{company}} asks for these documents for your application to {{job}}. Upload each as a PDF, JPG or PNG file of up to 10 MB:
document_request.note: Only the company that asked can open the files you upload.

documents_received.subject: {{candidate}} answered your document request
documents_received.heading: Documents received
body: {{candidate}} answered every item of your document request for {{job}}.
Open the request to view the files. Each opening is logged.

nextStep.applied: The company has your application. You will hear from them when it moves forward.
nextStep.under_review: The company is reviewing your application. No action is needed from you.
nextStep.interview: The company would like to talk. They will contact you about the interview.
nextStep.offer: The company is preparing an offer. They will contact you with the details.
nextStep.hired: Congratulations. The company chose you for this role.
nextStep.not_selected: The company chose not to move forward with this application.

pausedJobs.one: {{job}} stays live; 1 other job was paused. Subscribe again to republish it.
pausedJobs.other: {{job}} stays live; {{count}} other jobs were paused. Subscribe again to republish them.

interview.aiNotesLine: The recruiter would like AI notes of this interview. You will both be asked on screen at the start; nothing is recorded unless you both agree, and only the audio.
interview.released: The time you booked, {{when}}, is cancelled.

details.video: Video call in Local WorkMan: join from the interview card, from 10 minutes before the start.
details.phone_candidate: Phone call: the recruiter will call you on the phone number in your profile.

certificate.title: Certificate of completion
certificate.note: This certificate confirms that the course was completed and its final quiz passed. It does not verify workplace skills.

manager.name: Manager
manager.description: Supervises a team, manages recruitment activity, and reviews operational reporting.

accounts_head.name: Accounts Head
accounts_head.description: Oversees finance information, approvals, and financial reporting.

staff.name: Staff
staff.description: Provides limited operational access for day-to-day responsibilities.
